## F008 — docs sync

Trigger: daily at 2AM (schedule) or manually.

What it does: fetches the machine-readable corpus (docs.n8n.io/llms-full.txt) and reports the delta.

What it deliberately does not do: write files. The Code node has no writable-filesystem contract,
so persistence belongs to the local pipeline:

    python brain/scripts/refresh.py --apply

Measured 2026-11-12: this workflow imported, activated and executed against n8n 1.100.0.
